view.title: The Second Cairn
view.text:
Beside the road stands a second cairn. Its swords have fallen into the mud; no names are carved on its stones.

The keeper is not here. The road continues beyond it, and you cannot tell which way the keeper went.

choices.label: Loot the barrow (gain 120 cinders, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: You drag the fallen swords aside and prise the cinders from beneath them. Second time is easier. You leave the blades in the mud; that is the part that follows you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

outcome.resultText: You drag the fallen swords aside and prise the cinders from beneath them. Second time is easier. You leave the blades in the mud; that is the part that follows you.

view.title: Abandoned Merchant Cart
view.text: A trader’s cart lies tipped in the mud, one wheel still turning. Cinder-light glints from a split strongbox. The mud around it is churned with bootprints.

choices.label: Loot the strongbox (gain 75 cinders; the owners may object)
choices.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Not every gift is free. You keep walking.

outcome.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

view.title: The Caravan Comes Through
view.text:
The Road Warden stands beside Lantern Haven’s mud-spattered wagons. The last one carries the lantern you helped raise.

"You bought these people a road. We can pay our debt. That strongbox is for medicine at the next trading post; it belongs to the cold hamlets."

choices.label: Steal the emergency strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons onward, asking nothing in return.

outcome.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

view.title: Shrine of the Feral Ember
view.text: A shrine no church would recognize: antlers, wax, and old blood. Ember pools here anyway — wild, unattended, and guarded by something that has not left claw marks this fresh by accident.

choices.label: Take the offering (gain a random relic — its keeper objects)
choices.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Wild ember keeps its own accounts. You leave the ledger closed.

outcome.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

view.title: Ancient Cinder Stone
view.text: A standing stone hums with old script. Reading it makes your teeth ache and your hands steadier. It would also break beautifully.

choices.label: Study it (upgrade a random card, lose 7% max HP)
choices.resultText: The script rearranges something behind your eyes. You are sharper, and less.

choices.label: Smash it (gain 35 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone comes apart into cinder-light. The hum does not entirely stop.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some doors are better left unread.

outcome.resultText: The stone comes apart into cinder-light. The hum does not entirely stop.

view.title: Handspider Nest
view.text: A cluster of pale, many-jointed hands scuttles in the dark ahead, nested around a strongbox they have dragged from somewhere below. They have not noticed you. Yet.

choices.label: Snatch the strongbox (gain 80 cinders; they may wake)
choices.resultText: The box comes free with a wet scrape. All around you, fingers go still — then flex.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.resultText: You retrace your steps one careful footfall at a time. The nest never stirs.

outcome.resultText: The box comes free with a wet scrape. All around you, fingers go still — then flex.

view.title: Cinderbear Den
view.text: The cave reeks of musk and old kills. Cinder-light glitters in the bone-litter at the back — a fortune, if you are quiet, and quick, and the mound of fur by the wall keeps breathing slow.

choices.label: Go for the hoard (gain 100 cinders; it will almost certainly wake)
choices.resultText: Your hands fill with cold light. Behind you, the breathing stops.

choices.label: Skim the edges (squeeze past the rubble, lose 5% max HP, gain 25 cinders)
choices.resultText: You take only what is within reach and pay for it in scraped ribs. The den keeps its heart.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some fortunes are guarded by teeth. You leave this one to its keeper.

outcome.resultText: You take only what is within reach and pay for it in scraped ribs. The den keeps its heart.

view.title: Blight-Priest's Offer
view.text: A priest kneels in a ring of dead grass, robes fused to weeping skin. He is unbothered, almost radiant. "The Blight gives," he says, holding out a reliquary in one ruined hand. "It asks only a little flesh in return."

choices.label: Accept the blessing (gain a random relic; lose 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: His hand closes over yours. The reliquary is warm, and the warmth does not stop where your skin does.

choices.label: Rob him (gain 50 cinders; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: He does not resist. He only smiles wider, as if you have taken exactly what he meant you to.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "The Blight is patient," he calls after you. "It will keep your seat."

outcome.resultText: "The Blight is patient," he calls after you. "It will keep your seat."
